name: Tool — OpenAPI
summary: OpenApiTool: pass an OpenAPI 3.x spec so the agent can call any HTTP API as a tool.
description: On the official supported-tools list. Skips if OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH is unset; loads the spec from disk (a simple petstore.json works) and attaches it via OpenApiTool. Orchestrator model is BYOM-routed.
